design_rationale:
WHY THIS IS A GOOD TEST. A guest whose monthly rental turned out to be misrepresented asks only for Roamhaven's own service fee back. The service-fee rule says that refund is fixed only after the stay's ledger carries the nightly refund of that travel issue; the nightly rule says that refund is not fixed until the ledger carries the collection of every installment whose first night has arrived. The ledger shows installment 1 declined twice and nothing collected, so the agent must first hand installment 1 to the guest, then book the nightly refund on the nights it covers, then the fee refund that rests on it. The guest knows nothing of the decline. Each amount is a multi-factor computation over the stay, the request, the installment ledger, the CO-DENVER schedule and the guest's Rewards tier and ledger.

SCOPE. Occupied by task 0: stay_ext_departure_pet_fee_refund, stay_ext_departure_extra_guest_fee_refund, stay_ext_departure_service_fee_refund, stay_ext_departure_notice_charge and their four tools. Claimed here: stay_ext_first_installment_payment (pay_first_installment_26275b3d, owner=user), stay_ext_travel_issue_nightly_refund (refund_travel_nightly_d238de09), stay_ext_travel_issue_service_fee_refund (refund_travel_service_fee_041715de). Last task: the seven policies are now all claimed, pairwise disjoint.

DRAW (scripts/draw_counts.py --task 1): {"prerequisite_problems": 2, "factor_counts": [6, 4, 4]} -> nightly travel refund 6, travel service-fee refund 4, installment 1 payment 4.

PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root: stay_ext_travel_issue_service_fee_refund.
 (1) service-fee refund -> nightly refund, value_input, gate travel_fee_nightly_refunds, state form: "The service-fee refund of a travel issue is fixed only after the stay's ledger carries the nightly refund of that travel issue." False at frozen_time: the stay's ledger holds only the two stay_payment_failed rows (initial_state.stay_transactions.<T_S1_F1/T_S1_F2>.event_type). Only the nightly travel-refund policy books a nightly travel_issue entry.
 (2) nightly refund -> installment 1, value_input, gate travel_installments_collected, state form: "The nightly refund of a travel issue is not fixed until the stay's ledger carries the collection of every installment whose first night has arrived." False: installment 1's first night 2026-10-07 has arrived and both attempts failed. Only the installment-1 payment policy books an installment 1 collection, and it is the guest's own write (owner=user), handed over by the agent.
 Four-point test: each sentence joins the policy's own result (the fee refund's figure, "fixed only after"; the nightly refund's figure, "not ... until") to a record-visible ledger state; no tool, id or code token; hard wait at exact scope ("every installment whose first night has arrived" — on the check-in date that is installment 1). Chain, so the only order is installment 1, nightly refund, fee refund. value_input edges 2 >= 1.
 Deletion sensitivity (Step 5 run): without installment 1 the nightly refund evaluates to 0.00 (gold 2132.41); without the nightly refund on the ledger the fee refund evaluates to 35.09 (gold 289.62).

FACTOR CARD (Step 5 run on the handling-time world).
 Installment 1 (3648.80; all-baseline 8692.64): installment_one_coverage (monthly, 28+ nights: first 30 nights + cleaning = 3480.00; baseline whole stay -> 7083.20); installment_one_fee_rate (12.00; baseline 14.20 -> 3687.08); installment_one_fee_courtesy (rewards tier: Platinum priority support, no concierge -> 50% spared; baseline -> 3857.60); installment_one_tax (60 nights meet the 30-night exemption -> 0.00; baseline 15.75% -> 4196.90). Credits redeemed and not reinstated (40.00) are taken off in the baseline itself.
 Nightly travel refund (2132.41; all-baseline 6480.00): travel_severity_share (misrepresented 50; baseline 100 -> 3222.78); travel_loyalty_uplift (rewards ledger: two credit earnings in 24 months -> +10; baseline -> 1820.87); travel_tier_uplift (Platinum -> +5; baseline -> 1976.64); travel_paid_night_scope (installment 1 collected covers 30 nights; baseline all 60 affected nights -> 4227.21); travel_first_night_treatment (submitted on the check-in date -> first night 100%; baseline share -> 2094.81); travel_credit_funded_part (40.00 redeemed, none reinstated -> 0.9946854; baseline -> 2143.80; multi-source).
 Travel service-fee refund (289.62; all-baseline 302.80): travel_fee_percentage (12.00; baseline 14.20 -> 342.72); travel_fee_base_by_issue (misrepresented: nightly refund + whole cleaning fee 240.00; baseline nightly refund only -> 260.97); travel_fee_arrival_courtesy (submitted on the check-in date and priority support -> half of 108.00; baseline -> 283.18; multi-source); travel_fee_credit_funded_part (baseline -> 291.17).
 Near-misses and stale records: the two declined attempts show 3857.60 — the installment computed while the guest was Rewards Silver, before today's Platinum upgrade (the 2026 qualifying nights reached 40 when the Platt Park stay checked out this morning: 5 + 35; the 50.00 Platinum bonus is posted today) — so copying the declined amount misses the courtesy; the Platt Park stay that checked out today has not earned credits yet (credits post a day after check-out), so the loyalty uplift counts two earnings, not three; the listing's own cleaning fee is not refunded for a misrepresented listing, but it does enter the fee base.

BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Installment 1 (subject stay_payment_collected): stay_evt_payment_schedule — the stay is checked_in (money may be collected), the first failed attempt was 2026-10-06T19:02:30, so the 48-hour grace runs to 2026-10-08T19:02:30 and a collection now keeps the stay; stay_evt_alteration — not an alteration increase. Refunds (subject stay_refund_issued): the travel request is approved and was reported 3 h 05 min after discovery (inside 72 h); the cancellation-window gates do not bear on a travel-issue refund (the stay is not cancelled; travel refunds are not limited by the tier); no earlier nightly or service-fee refund exists on the stay (the cited nightly and service-fee rows belong to the 2025 cancelled Platt Park stay); the cap never counts travel refunds; refund_stage before_payout_release (no release record; earliest release 2026-10-08T00:00).

BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Target stay HQ5VD8L2XP and request (approved misrepresented). Rows on the target before the call: the two declined attempts. Excluded: the four Platt Park stays (2025 completed, 2025 cancelled with full-window refunds, 2026 completed, 2026 Long-Term completed today) — read for the Rewards history and as component evidence. Every new row carries the target stay_id; both refunds carry the request id.

INITIAL_STATE ROWS. customers (guest + host), host_accounts and two listings of the same host (FK closure, read through find_listings by host account), five stays, thirteen ledger rows, the travel request, the Rewards membership (Platinum, active, valid through 2027-12-31) and five Rewards rows (24.41 earned 2025-04-16, 10.00 Silver bonus, 14.51 earned 2026-06-16, 40.00 redeemed on the target 2026-10-05, 50.00 Platinum bonus today). No automatic clause is due: the grace period is still running, earnings release tomorrow, the completed stay's credits post tomorrow.

PERSONA. Tomasz Brennan, calm and dry, asks only for Roamhaven's fee back; gives phone, then date of birth, then email on request; confirmation code when asked; does not know about the decline; agrees to pay at once when told and runs the handed-over payment with the values given; agrees to Roamhaven's other entries; closes when told the fee refund is issued. He never names amounts, installments or a nightly refund.

STANDARD SOLUTION. Locate; verify; read stays, the travel request, the stay ledger, the Rewards membership and ledger, the listing by host account and the host's payout records for the stay; unlock and hand over installment 1 (3648.80); book the nightly travel refund 2132.41; book the travel service-fee refund 289.62.

VERIFICATION. _work/proto.py reused check_compute's evaluator on the handling-time worlds: installment 1 3648.80; nightly 2132.41 (0.00 before installment 1); fee 289.62 (35.09 before the nightly refund); factor figures as listed.

DRAFT FROM THE VISIBLE CONTEXT. From the published rules, schemas, finder returns and persona alone: the fee refund waits on the nightly refund, which waits on installment 1; installment 1 = 30 nights x 108.00 + 240.00, fee 12% halved for Platinum, no tax (60 >= 30), less 40.00; nightly = 108.00 x (100 + 29 x 65)/100 x (1 - 40/7526.40); fee = (nightly + 240.00 + 54.00) x 12% x the same card share. Same writes, order and amounts as gold.

REVISIONS (symptom -> root cause -> change -> re-run). (1) An hour-based arrival window could not be computed (the expression language has no time arithmetic below a day) -> the first-night treatment keys on the submission date and a separate Rewards tier uplift factor was added. (2) check_extended: installment 1 had one parameter factor -> a Rewards fee courtesy factor was added; to keep the baseline paragraph equal to the all-fall-through result, tax stays a declared factor and the credit offset is part of the baseline. (3) Tuple syntax is not allowed in compute -> rewritten as an or-test. (4) The declined attempts would have revealed the answer if they equalled today's installment -> the world records them at the pre-upgrade amount 3857.60 (Rewards Silver), and today's upgrade to Platinum (40 qualifying 2026 nights reached when the Platt Park stay checked out; 50.00 bonus posted today) makes the courtesy apply now. (5) Policy-task audit round 1 -> F-1: the installment-1 fee courtesy departed from base 'each installment carries the guest service fee and occupancy tax attributable to the amounts it collects' with overwrite: [] -> the first-installment rule now declares that overwrite and scopes the courtesy to installment 1 of a monthly stay, following the tier active when installment 1 is collected (multi-source tier: payment plan AND Rewards tier), so the declined attempts (scheduled under Silver) and today's payment (Platinum) both follow the rule; the flat per-night tax of a pay-part-now installment 1 now carries the deposit share (O-2). F-4: the first affected night reported the day after check-in takes the higher of 75% and the share, never less than the other nights. O-3: on a pay-part-now stay the deposit share reaches the first affected night too. F-5: the credit-funded part no longer reads earlier refunds. O-4: the travel tools' stay_id text corrected. Amounts unchanged (3648.80 / 2132.41 / 289.62).

GATES RUN (repo root): check_extended --task 1 -> EXTENDED OK; check_task_tools --task 1 -> TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK; replay_tasks --task 1 -> REPLAY OK (15 actions, closure 30 = initial 30); check_solvability --task 1 -> SOLVABILITY OK (19 gates); check_compute --task 1 -> COMPUTE OK (14 factors, 6 cross-difficulty); check_grounding --task 1 -> GROUNDING OK; check_cache_diff --task 1 -> CACHE-DIFF INFO; check_cross_fire --task 1 -> SCOPE OK. Difficulty-wide: EXTENDED OK, TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK, REPLAY OK, SOLVABILITY OK, COMPUTE OK (suite branches mean 66.50, steps mean 16.00, history max 10, branches max 72), GROUNDING OK, SCOPE OK. check_traceability deferred until the KB is rendered. Round 2 re-run on the reworked charter (difficulty-wide): EXTENDED OK; TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK; REPLAY OK (15 actions, closure 30 = initial 30); SOLVABILITY OK (19 gates); COMPUTE OK (14 factors, 6 cross-difficulty); GROUNDING OK; CACHE-DIFF INFO; SCOPE OK; check_traceability still waits for the published KB.

DIFFICULTY CLOSURE. Seven extended policies, all claimed: task 0 {departure pet-fee, extra-guest-fee and service-fee refunds, notice charge}, task 1 {installment 1 payment, travel nightly refund, travel service-fee refund}; scopes and tools pairwise disjoint; every policy recomputed at its gold call; no handoff in gold.
user_scenario:
You are Tomasz Brennan, 46, a travelling surgical nurse who moves between monthly rentals for hospital contracts. This morning you checked out of a garden apartment in Platt Park, Denver, and this afternoon you checked into a two-month rental, a house near Washington Park, booked through Roamhaven. The listing promised three bedrooms and a primary suite; the third bedroom turned out to be a storage room with a futon and there is no suite at all. You reported it in the app this afternoon and Roamhaven approved your report this evening. Your host, Lauren, apologised and said she would sort things out on her end. What you want from this call is Roamhaven's own service fee back for a place that is not what Roamhaven advertised; you say so calmly, a bit dry, and you do not bring up anything else.
When the agent asks who you are, give your mobile number, 3035551274; if a second detail is needed, your date of birth, 1979-11-08; only if they still need more, your email, tomasz.brennan@proton.me. If asked which reservation, it is the Washington Park house, confirmation code HQ5VD8L2XP, checked in today, 7 October. You don't know any amounts and never guess one.
You did not know about any problem with your payment; you switched banks last week. If the agent tells you a payment on this reservation was declined and has to be made before anything else, you say you'll pay it right away with your new card, and when the agent hands the payment to you, you make it yourself with exactly the reservation and amount the agent gives you and read out the receipt. If the agent says Roamhaven has other entries to put through on the reservation, you tell them to go ahead. Once the agent tells you the service fee refund has been issued, you thank them and end the call; you have nothing else to raise.

base_preconditions.condition: The cap counts guest-cancellation service-fee refunds only; travel-issue refunds are never capped and never counted.

The booking grace period is met when the guest cancels no more than booking_grace_hours elapsed hours after the reservation was booked; grace hours are counted as elapsed clock time from booked_at to cancelled_at, never as calendar days, and a tier whose booking_grace_hours is 0 has no grace period.
The booking grace period also requires the cancellation date to fall at least grace_min_lead_days calendar days before the stay's check-in date.

The full-refund window is met when the cancellation date falls at least full_refund_cutoff_days calendar days before the stay's check-in date; a tier whose full_refund_cutoff_days is 0 has no full-refund window.

The partial-refund window is met when the cancellation date falls at least partial_window_cutoff_days calendar days before the stay's check-in date and neither earlier window is met; a partial_window_cutoff_days of 0 means the partial window runs up to and including the day before check-in, and also covers a cancellation dated on the check-in date before the stay is checked in.
A guest-cancellation refund for the same stay and the same charge component is issued only once.
A host-cancellation refund for the same stay and the same charge component is issued only once.
A travel-issue refund is issued only when Roamhaven has approved the travel-issue request.

A travel issue is eligible only when the guest reported it no more than travel_issue_report_hours elapsed hours after the guest discovered the issue; the hours are counted in elapsed clock time from the request's issue_discovered_at to its submitted_at.
Its approval gate concerns refunds resting on an approved major-disruptive-event request; this refund rests on an approved travel-issue request.
Alteration refunds rest on an accepted date or guest-count change; the stay's only request is a travel issue.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: 3648.80. Monthly-installment stay of 60 nights: installment 1 carries the first 30 nights at 108.00 (6480.00/60) = 3240.00 plus the cleaning fee 240.00 = 3480.00; guest service fee 12.00% (split fee, 28+ nights) = 417.60, halved by the Rewards Platinum courtesy (priority support, no concierge) = 208.80; occupancy tax 0.00 (60 nights meet the CO-DENVER 30-night exemption); less 40.00 credits redeemed and not reinstated: 3480.00 + 208.80 + 0.00 - 40.00 = 3648.80. The first-installment rule supersedes, as a declared overwrite, base 'each installment carries the guest service fee and occupancy tax attributable to the amounts it collects' for installment 1 of a monthly stay, the courtesy following the Rewards tier active when installment 1 is collected; the two declined attempts of 3857.60 were scheduled at confirmation on 2026-10-06 while the guest was Rewards Silver (no priority line, so no courtesy), before today's upgrade. Fall-backs: whole stay -> 7083.20; 14.20% -> 3687.08; no courtesy -> 3857.60; percentage tax 15.75% -> 4196.90.

edges.condition: stay_transactions holds the stay_refund_issued row with charge_component nightly and refund_reason travel_issue carrying the approved request's request_id.
edges.policy_source: The service-fee refund of a travel issue is fixed only after the stay's ledger carries the nightly refund of that travel issue.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The stay's ledger holds only two stay_payment_failed rows; no travel_issue nightly refund is on it.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 12 posts the nightly travel_issue refund of 2132.41 carrying the request id; travel_fee_nightly_refunds rises from 0.00 to 2132.41.

edges.condition: stay_transactions holds a stay_payment_collected row for every installment whose first night is on or before the handling date; for a monthly stay on its check-in date that is installment 1.
edges.policy_source: The nightly refund of a travel issue is not fixed until the stay's ledger carries the collection of every installment whose first night has arrived.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: Installment 1's first night (2026-10-07) has arrived, but both of its collection attempts were declined (event_type stay_payment_failed); no stay_payment_collected row exists on the stay.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 10 posts the installment 1 collection of 3648.80; travel_installments_collected rises from 0 to 1 and the covered affected nights from 0 to 30.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The tree is a chain (service-fee refund -> nightly refund -> installment 1); each write reads the one before it, so the only admissible order is installment 1, nightly refund, service-fee refund.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without the nightly travel refund on the ledger the service-fee refund evaluates to 35.09 instead of 289.62 (fee base = cleaning fee 240.00 + courtesy 54.00 only), and the terminal ledger lacks the 2132.41 refund.
Without installment 1 collected the nightly travel refund evaluates to 0.00 instead of 2132.41 (no affected night is paid), so no refund can be booked and the service-fee refund falls to 35.09.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The persona asks only for Roamhaven's service fee back; it does not know the payment was declined and never mentions installments or a nightly refund. The host's apology is a caller statement that names no Roamhaven entry; the payment and the other entries reach him only as passive reactions to what the agent says.
